title: Two bridges complete coastal road link between Kollam and Koyilandy harbour

content: 'You need to introspect': Amit Shah says Rahul Gandhi should not blame EC, SIR for Congress' poll defeats

title: Messi to present Ballon d’Or despite nomination, Yamal dilemma looms
content: Lionel Messi could reportedly present the 2026 Ballon d’Or trophy in London, despite being among the 30 nominees himself. The rumour has sparked memes and speculation about Lamine Yamal winning, given their famous connection. While Messi’s family could attend, neither his presenting role nor his attendance has been confirmed, leaving fans guessing ahead of the October 26 ceremony.

title: Elon Musk pours $276 million into Republican groups ahead of 2026 midterms
content: Since July, Elon Musk has poured over $276 million into Republican political factions, including a critical $158 million aimed at the Senate Leadership Fund, bolstering Republican Senate candidates. With his overall political spending this election cycle hitting around $366 million, this shift marks a departure from his earlier intent to rein in contributions. This revelation comes as the Federal Election Commission deadline looms ahead.

title: 'Lady hiding in Dehradun': Who was Rahul referring to at INDIA bloc presser?
content: During the INDIA bloc's press conference, Rahul Gandhi's reference to a "lady hiding right now in Dehradun" raised questions about whom he was referring to. The remark came amid the opposition's campaign against CEC Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral-roll irregularities.

title: Centre asks states to go into ‘mission mode’ to curb stubble burning
content: The Centre has instructed Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana, and Delhi-NCR to prevent stubble burning. Recent data showed a significant rise in farm fires especially in Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan. States are required to implement action plans that urgently address the issue of crop residue burning. Effective monitoring strategies have been emphasized to ensure compliance and control.

title: Tony Robbins’ hunger campaign grew from 100 million meals to 1 billion
content: Inspired by his childhood experience with food assistance during Thanksgiving, Tony Robbins has made hunger relief a central cause. Partnering with Feeding America, he initiated the 100 Million Meals Challenge in 2014, ultimately aiming for a billion meals. This ambitious goal was met in 2023, leading to a new target to provide another billion meals by 2035, reflecting Robbins' commitment to combating food insecurity in the U.S.

title: Maine dismantles new bridge spans two months after collapse injured workers
content: Following a tragic collapse on August 13, demolition teams are onsite dismantling the damaged portions of the Llewellyn Estes Bridge, which was under construction over the Stillwater River in Old Town. Several workers sustained injuries during the incident and received urgent medical care. Authorities are launching a comprehensive investigation to uncover the precise reasons behind the failure while prioritizing safety in the preparation for future bridge construction.

title: US issues power grid emergency in 13 states: Reason and what it means for residents
content: In a decisive move to ensure grid stability during a peak demand period, US Secretary of Energy Chris Wright has empowered PJM Interconnection to manage local power generation units from October 13 to October 16. With temperatures hitting unseasonably high levels, demand has surged to approximately 111,500 megawatts on October 13. While residents are not required to take action, voluntary conservation measures may be recommended.

title: Hazlewood’s six-wicket haul takes him past Lee, equals Ishant and Zaheer
content: In a remarkable display of skill, Josh Hazlewood surpassed the legendary Brett Lee's Test wicket record during the first Test against South Africa in Durban. Achieving his career-best with a six-wicket haul, Hazlewood ended up with eight wickets. This stellar performance was pivotal in Australia's commanding 214-run win, solidifying his status as one of the greatest fast bowlers in Australia's Test history.

title: India exports 18-coach LHB train to Bangladesh with CCTVs and baby care rooms
content: Bangladesh Railway placed a fresh order through RITES in 2024 for the manufacture and supply of 200 broad-gauge passenger coaches. The order covers seven different variants and further deepens the association between the two organisations. The coaches have been customised to suit Bangladesh Railway's operational requirements while providing passengers with greater comfort.

title: High tea after street heat: What happened at INDIA bloc meet at Rahul Gandhi's residence
content: Leaders from the INDIA bloc held a meeting at Rahul Gandhi's residence to protest vote theft allegations against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. They expressed their commitment to continue the protests and seek accountability from those responsible for undermining democracy. Various leaders spoke about the fight for fair elections and the need to hold officials accountable. They emphasized that their efforts would persist across the nation.

title: New Jersey couple’s viral homeless veteran story raised $400,000; it was fabricated
content: Katelyn McClure and Mark D'Amico launched a heartfelt campaign to support Johnny Bobbitt Jr, a homeless veteran, asserting that he heroically assisted McClure during a fuel mishap. This poignant story garnered around $400,000 from over 14,000 donors, who were unaware of the deception. Upon investigation, it was revealed that the couple misappropriated the contributions for lavish purchases while Bobbitt pursued legal recourse for his funds.

title: IIT Kanpur alumnus, 61, struggles to find US tech job for nearly two years
content: Gautam Dev, a 61-year-old software engineer, is battling the challenges of finding full-time employment after his recent job loss. Financial hardships have forced him to turn to gig work and launch a GoFundMe fundraiser for support. With numerous job applications yielding no success and debts mounting, the uncertainty of his future is prompting him to think about relocating back to India as he nears eligibility for Social Security.

title: US school bus driver removed from route after letting 10-year-old rescue kitten
content: Cynthia Morgan, a dedicated school bus driver in Maryland, was dismissed after she permitted a student to save a kitten. This decision has ignited discussions on student welfare and the appropriateness of the response. Parents and locals are rallying for her return as support grows. The school district insists on safety protocols, reflecting on Morgan's history with students, prompting an evaluation of transport safety rules and disciplinary actions.

title: RBI steps in with big measures for rupee, but should it let currency fall instead?
content: One thought process is that the RBI should allow the market forces to let the rupee find its levels. Indeed the IMF recently said that India should allow the exchange rate to act as a shock absorber. Interestingly, RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra believes that the rupee is actually undervalued. What should RBI do?

title: UK shopper paid £15 for royal family ring; it later sold for £5,500
content: In a remarkable find, a shopper in Leicester stumbled upon a gold mourning ring at a charity shop, purchasing it for just £15. Auction experts linked the ring to Princess Amelia, revealing its royal connection. The ring, crafted in her honor, fetched an impressive £5,500 at Hansons Auctioneers, igniting a fierce bidding war that exceeded estimates, underscoring its historical significance within the royal family's mourning traditions.

title: ‘Papa, please save me’: Shekhar Suman remembers son Aayush’s final moments at 11
content: Shekhar Suman shared his struggles while his son Aayush battled a terminal illness at a young age. He faced significant emotional and financial challenges during this difficult time and continued working despite the personal turmoil. Aayush's poignant last words and the family's decision to ease his suffering haunt Shekhar even years later. Shekhar expressed that the tragedy has permanently affected their lives and remains a part of their everyday experiences.

title: 'Agreed to build on positive momentum in ties': PM Modi speaks with Canada PM Carney
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney discussed enhancing the strategic partnership between India and Canada. The leaders emphasized collaboration on trade, energy, technology, and security matters. Both nations aim to finalize a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement by December to boost bilateral trade significantly. Modi's potential visit to Canada would mark his first since diplomatic tensions arose previously.

title: Iran seeking to expand attacks in UK to military sites, MI5 chief warns
content: Iran is reportedly increasing its focus on military targets in Britain, including RAF Fairford. The suspected plot against the air base has prompted significant security responses and investigations. British authorities believe the incident may have links to Iran's Revolutionary Guard. Additionally, MI5 chief Ken McCallum highlighted broader trends in Iran's threat activities this year. The rise of state threats and the potential misuse of artificial intelligence were also addressed.

title: Ashwin reveals what drove Bhuvneshwar's India comeback
content: Bhuvneshwar Kumar's selection for the T20I series against New Zealand showcases his impressive form with RCB. Ravichandran Ashwin emphasized that Bhuvneshwar concentrated on honing his skills instead of aiming for a comeback on the national team. Ashwin is optimistic about India's prospects in the upcoming 2027 ODI World Cup, attributing this to solid bowling assets and seasoned hitters. He pointed out South Africa's strength, citing their understanding of local conditions.

title: Delhi man with 14 criminal cases shot dead, CCTV captures killing
content: Mosin Khan, known for his extensive criminal background, was shot in Delhi and later died in the hospital due to his injuries. The police were alerted to the incident and have since launched an investigation at Ranhola police station. Currently, authorities are exploring the motives behind the shooting and actively pursuing the suspects involved.

title: Ohio brothers bought flooded quarry for $330,000; village later drops seizure bid
content: Two Ohio brothers bought a flooded quarry for $330,000 in 2005 and spent 15 years improving it before a dispute with the Village of Luckey disrupted their planned sale. After nearly five years of litigation, the village abandoned its attempt to acquire the property through eminent domain but now faces a $206,000 legal bill, with the settlement still under dispute.Is this conversation helpful so far?

title: Yuvraj Singh joins Delhi Capitals coaching staff ahead of new IPL season
content: Yuvraj Singh has been appointed as the Assistant and Batting Coach for Delhi Capitals in IPL. This role is his first formal coaching position following a distinguished cricket career. He previously played for the franchise, which adds to the significance of this appointment. Yuvraj expressed his enthusiasm about working with former captain Sourav Ganguly and the talented squad.

title: New York charity accused of using nearly $100,000 in veteran donations for insiders
content: A New York veterans' charity called Healing for Heroes allegedly misused donations intended for injured service members. State prosecutors filed a civil lawsuit claiming founders misled donors while using funds for personal luxuries. Investigators found that the charity operated retreats only for board members and their friends, neglecting actual veterans seeking support. Additionally, the charity reportedly made almost $33,000 from rental income but did not benefit the veterans.

title: Lancashire friends built £2,000-plus gaming shed; it later won Shed of the Year
content: A tabletop gaming shed built by Chris Otterburn and his friends in Lancashire has won Britain's 2026 Shed of the Year competition. Featuring an 18-foot gaming table, storage space and a tea-making station, the shed also includes a memorial to their friend Scott Forrest, who died of cancer before its completion.
